model_output: This is a C++ implementation of a binary search tree, with the `searchBST` function used to search for a specific value in the tree. The function takes in the root node of the tree, as well as the value to search for, and returns a pointer to the node if it is found. The function uses a while loop to repeatedly compare the value of the current node with the search value. If the value is greater than the search value, the function goes to the right child node. If the value is less than the search value, the function goes to the left child node. The function stops when the current node is either the search value or null, and returns a pointer to the current node.
